parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested in human assays against the human CB2 receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering for the human CB2 receptor target and human assay organism. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Return one row per compound with columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id ascending.
